description: Defines classes and structures for starting a MAC-FAPI procedure to initiate L1 processing, including configuration, dependencies, and transaction handling.

classes.name: mac_fapi_start_cell_procedure
classes.description: Handles the sequence of messages and transactions to start L1 processing in the MAC-FAPI protocol.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the start cell procedure asynchronously.

methods.description: Processes the result of the PARAM transaction.

methods.name: handle_start_transaction_result
